checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Two separate assets, poster and 8s reel, both vertical 9:16
must.why: Poster is 9:16 and the reel frames are vertical 9:16.

must.item: Both assets contain all five text strings spelled exactly
must.why: All five strings are present and correct in the poster and in every sampled reel frame.

must.item: Both show warm illustrated food stalls and string lights with a matching palette and design
must.why: The reel starts from the poster, but it drifts toward a more photographic look and the camera moves.

must.item: Reel has visible background animation while details stay readable throughout
must.why: Background moves a lot, but string lights drift over the date and time lines at 5.6s and 7.6s. Lights also overlap 'Market'. Riverside Yard is partly over the dumplings at 3.2s.
Audio cannot be checked from frames. The assistant said it has no sound.

faults.what: Reel camera and scene move strongly (a push or pan), although the assistant said the camera stays still. The scene changes a lot from start to end.
Glowing string-light bulbs pass over the 'Saturday 12 July' and '6–10 pm' text and the 'Market' lettering, which reduces readability.
Riverside Yard and Free entry sit over busy food items at the bottom, with weaker contrast at 3.2s.
Stall signs show gibberish pseudo-text, and the stall sign text morphs in the reel.
The reel drifts from flat illustration toward a photo-like look, and the cook and foreground bowls leave the frame.

summary: The poster is clean and the text is correct, but the reel moves the whole scene and string lights cross the date and time lines, so it is not fully readable throughout.
